description: This file defines the ValidationUserNameAPI class, which provides an API endpoint to validate the uniqueness of a username within the OrangeHRM system. The class extends an Endpoint base class and implements ResourceEndpoint, utilizing various traits and dependencies to perform its function. It includes method handling for GET requests to check if a username is available, as well as validation rules for request parameters.

classes.name: ValidationUserNameAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint used for validating the uniqueness of a username for administrative users within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to validate whether a username is available, optionally considering a user ID for updates.
